data.narrative:
Parry Labs is a Series B-stage defense and security company founded by John Parkes and Robert Miller that has raised $80M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set of eight same-sector, same-stage private companies and two public comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS).

Two triangulation methods are applied. Stage-progression analysis uses total capital raised ($80M) as a value proxy and applies a 1.9x multiplier typical for Series B advancement, implying a valuation of $152M. Peer-median analysis anchors to the median valuation of eight Defense & Security companies at Series B stage, which stands at $1.1B; the peer range spans $300M to $3.0B, with named comparables including Dream Security ($3.0B), Allen Control Systems ($2.2B), Harmattan AI ($1.4B), Code Metal ($1.2B), and Twenty ($1.0B).

The two methods produce a wide implied range: $152M (stage-progression) versus $1.1B (peer-median). Triangulating across both approaches yields a median valuation of $638M, with a full range from $129M (low) to $1.3B (high). The material spread between methods reflects asymmetry in peer valuations within the defense-tech sector and uncertainty regarding Parry Labs' relative commercial traction and defensibility versus the peer cohort. Key uncertainties include product maturity, customer concentration, and IP strength relative to the $300M–$3.0B peer band.
